verdict.rationale: Vapi's first-party docs describe two testing paths. Voice Test Suites use an AI tester that calls the agent and follows a script simulating real customer behavior. Evals is a testing framework for assistants and squads that uses mock conversations with automated validation "before production." Together these cover both simulated conversations and evals as the story asks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing features.
